\[
\log_8 (a_1 \cdot a_2 \cdot \cdots \cdot a_{12}) = 2006

\[
a_1 \cdot a_2 \cdot \cdots \cdot a_{12} = 8^{2006}
\]

a^{12} \cdot r^{0+1+2+\cdots+11} = a^{12} \cdot r^{66}

a^{12} \cdot r^{66} = 8^{2006}

a^{12} \cdot r^{66} = (2^3)^{2006} = 2^{6018}
